# cosmos.gl

> cosmos.gl is an open-source, MIT-licensed TypeScript library for interactive network graphs and point clouds in the browser. It runs force-directed layout and rendering on the GPU using WebGL 2 and luma.gl.

Install the library with `npm install @cosmos.gl/graph`. Create a `Graph` in a DOM container and await `graph.ready` for initialization. Pass point coordinates to `setPointPositions` as a `Float32Array` of interleaved x and y values. Add optional links with `setLinks`, using pairs of zero-based point indices in a `Float32Array`, then call `render()`.

Use the force simulation for layouts driven by links, repulsion, clustering, or collision. Disable the simulation with `enableSimulation: false` to render a fixed layout or a point cloud. Point and link styling can be supplied through typed arrays.

cosmos.gl was created by Nikita Rokotyan, Olya Stukova, and Denis Ovsyannikov. [Creator credits](https://cosmos.gl/#creators)
